about.label: Personal Profile
about.text: My name is Bhargavsinh Sisodiya. I use my personal website as a central place to present my educational journey, creative projects, writing, technical experiments and interests in cultural preservation.
about.heading: Personal Identity

about.label: Academic Background
about.text: I am pursuing a Bachelor of Computer Applications (BCA) at Mahisagar College, Lunawada, under Shri Govind Guru University, following the NEP-2020 academic framework.
about.heading: Academic Journey

about.label: Technical Interests
about.text: Web development is one of my principal technical interests. I use my portfolio and related projects to practise website structure, styling, responsive design, content organization and deployment.
about.heading: Technology & Web Development

about.label: Literary Contributions
about.text: Writing is an important part of my creative work. I develop Gujarati manuscripts and literary projects that explore reflection, personal identity, social questions, values and narrative storytelling.
about.heading: Gujarati Literature & Authorship

about.label: Research Interests
about.text: I am interested in using digital technology to organize literature, historical information, family records and cultural resources. Digital preservation can include meaningful categorization, searchable information, readable documents, source attribution, backups and maintenance over time.
about.heading: Digital Archives & Knowledge Preservation

about.label: Heritage & Institutional Context
about.text: My family identity and interest in historical heritage form an important part of my personal story. I have a particular interest in Mewar and the historical legacy associated with Shri Maharana Pratap Singhji.
about.heading: Family Heritage & Mewar

institution.title: Anand Vihar Bhavan

institution.text: Anand Vihar Bhavan is associated with my personal, devotional and creative world. It is also the publisher name I use for my publishing-related work.
